contract.boundary: Browser presentation only. No Rust action/command, AST/view/journal/operation field, schema/ABI/history/recovery revision, native dependency or default startup change.
contract.owner: createFullscreen(editor.fullscreen()) or explicit connected ancestor target. Raw DOM coordinators implement the same port. One target claim and pending/active document lease, with native current-target and shadow retargeting checks; never adopt or exit a foreign session.
contract.entry: Exact idle owner publication outside composition. requestFullscreen is called synchronously before callbacks/microtasks from the direct user-gesture path. No unrelated await, CSS-only fallback, prefixed substitution or keyboard lock.
contract.focus: No remount or reparent, remote hold or authoring transaction. Restore only the same current native publication and connected focus node, never after source/interaction/focus/composition changes. Host fields and carets are not rewound; exit remains available during composition.
contract.lifetime: Controller explicitly owned by application; await dispose before replacing target/editor. Pending late entry is cleaned, owned exit failures retain a retiring retry handle/lease, foreign topmost sessions are not exited. Host closure initiates cleanup, not a document save guarantee.
contract.controls: Vanilla mount and React BreditorFullscreenControls borrow only the controller. UI disposal/StrictMode/rekey never exits fullscreen or closes the editor/writer. Initial labels/options remain immutable for each controls key.
